propositions: Parallel agent sessions hand-roll rebase-to-tip-then-submit logic and race, causing thrash and merging an untested tree.

A single-instance serial loop must atomically rebase a front Autosubmit+submittable change chain to tip, await fresh Verified +1, and ancestor-atomic submit the exact tested SHA with no intermediate thrash.
The loop polls on a fixed 15 s cadence, selects Autosubmit+1 changes via FIFO + RelatedChanges detection, and routes to rebase vs rebase:chain vs single-change based on chain structure.
The loop holds and advances a single wipChain state machine with a bounded N=5 re-drive limit and FFO TOCTOU guards to prevent concurrent state mutations.
The loop must maintain the R5 invariant: the tested tree equals the merged tree, achieved by reading existing Verified votes only and casting no votes itself.
